dose_response.note: two fixed doses only; no extrapolation to untested stronger dose

cell_level.note: cell-level descriptive; not 25 independent samples; no cell selection

OBSERVED: Inject is direct voltage; primary steady subthreshold increment DV_inf=0.20, low=0.10.
Observed matched KC increment +0.022858 (primary) and +0.011632 (low); all 25 seeds positive.
KC response is widespread: 311/320 matched KCs positive, 3 negative, 6 zero; top 1% contributes only ~4% of mean.
No matched KC saturation: primary max rate 0.5734 <0.85; zero cells >=0.95.
Matched KC positive, other KC mean -0.002287; full-4064 mean -0.000308.
KC effect is sustained across 100-300, not a failed short-window transient; post-window residual small.
SUPPORTED_HYPOTHESIS: The small response is consistent with threshold/subthreshold gating and post-spike reset limiting the effective rate increment; two-dose ratio ~0.509 is consistent with the DV ratio 0.5 but does not prove linearity.
Non-injected KC negative shift is consistent with network interaction/redistribution; it is descriptive, not causal.
UNKNOWN: Actual voltage trajectories, threshold distance, synaptic currents, and the relative contribution of reset vs network input are not recorded.
Whether a stronger direct voltage dose would produce interpretable biology cannot be inferred by linear extrapolation.

decision.A: A new independent KC-drive dose experiment could test a prespecified dose range, but current data cannot justify stronger dose selection and no voltage traces exist.
decision.B: Pause stronger stimulation; first validate LIF/network and biological-drive semantics, including subthreshold voltage and reset behavior.
falsifiable_hypotheses: H1 threshold: most nonresponding KCs stay below threshold; responders sit near threshold. If voltage traces contradict, reject.
H2 reset: post-spike reset dominates the rate ceiling; if traces/rate relation contradict, reject.
H3 network: negative other-KC shift comes from shared network input; if isolated/voltage traces show none, reject.
H4 aggregation: KC response is transient and hidden by window averaging; already contradicted by sustained bins.
stop_conditions: No voltage/current traces or semantic mismatch between FlyBrain inject and intended biological drive.
Proposed run exceeds 900 s / 2048 MiB or requires a new authorization absent.
KC saturation or no monotonic dose response in a validated model.
Any attempt to extrapolate a stronger dose without a new preregistration.
decision.next_experiment_candidate: B-first: an independent model-semantics/voltage-trace study (or a validated LIF/current mapping) before any stronger KC stimulation. A dose experiment only after that, with prespecified doses and voltage monitoring.

answers.q2_strongest_observation: The KC response is significant but only 0.0229, far below the +0.10 gate, despite DV_inf=0.20; it is widespread, not a few-cell artifact, and not saturated.
answers.q3_likely_limiter: SUPPORTED_HYPOTHESIS: threshold/reset/effective-voltage gating (and possibly network redistribution); exact cause UNKNOWN.
answers.q4_next_direction: B: pause stronger stimulation and validate model/biological-drive semantics with voltage/current traces; A only after that.
answers.q5_no_extrapolation: Do not infer a stronger dose from the approximate low/primary ratio.
